The Crossroads at Hollow Gate (invented for DMbot's tests; every name here is made up)

Hollow Gate is a walled crossroads town where the north road meets the river road. Hilda Brask keeps the Lantern Inn by the gate, and Warden Orrin Teal keeps the gate itself.

Four travellers have come to Hollow Gate together: Cerric Vanya'elen, Belleros Stormgrace, Okthandom Korran and Claude Ambere.
